book.name: Maliku
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Maliku gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Ba fi Jiso Yɛlusalɛm njɛ Nfoŋ
Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo jiɛnyɛ bo gɛ̀ doo bo fɛɛse Yɛlusalɛm, mbebe yi ntɛ wu Bɛfash bɛ wu Bɛtani le, bo nyume mbebe yi Mbegɛ wu Bite bi Olif le, wu baa booŋ be ba ŋgoo bafɛɛ wu tuŋ,
wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ ntɛ wù fwe wege le. Bɛŋ lé bɛŋ lêese yo nɛ kimimia, bɛŋ yɛŋ mwa jaki le ba shuudɛ, muh baaŋ yu a bɛɛŋ gɛ, bɛŋ fâanyɛ bɛŋ tô bɛ wu.
Nɛ muh le wu biih bɛŋ le laa bɛŋ faanyi nje la lɛ, bɛŋ chvuu lɛ chiji kikwɛɛ goone lo, wu lé wu kâasɛ wu chvuu jiŋ gɛh mɛɛ mɛɛ.”

content: Bo mo bo ja bo gɛɛŋ bo yɛŋ mwa jaki wuyu le ba shuudɛ a yeh yimi nfwɛɛŋ mbebe yi je le. Bo mo bo faanyɛ.
Bo doo bo faanyi bamii bamu ba gɛ̀ lɛme fo biih bo le lɛ, “Bɛŋ faanyi mwa jaki wɛɛ nje la?”
Bo mo bo sɛɛŋ bo fiɛɛ fì Jiso be jɛmɛ. Bo chinɛ bo gɛɛne bɛ wu.
Bo to bɛ wu fɛ Jiso le, bo dɛŋ njú yiboo yi nyaŋ yiyu le, Jiso mo wu bɛɛŋ yu.
Bamii ba duude tu bo dɛŋe njú a je, bamu shwage chɛ́ yi bite nchvuuŋ, bo dɛŋe tɛ a je.
Bamii ba gɛ̀ gɛɛne Jiso fwe mo ba gɛ̀ bii ajiŋ bo wuule lɛ, “Yilili Yilili,
mbɛɛŋsɛ nyûme fɛ Nyo le lɛɛɛ! Nyo le wu noŋ kimbonɛ yi muh wù too a jee chi Tada le lɛɛɛ!
Nyo le wu noŋ kimbonɛ yi bvunfoŋ bvu chiji wese besabɛŋ wù Dabi le bvù too le! Yilili Yilili, mbɛɛŋsɛ nyûme fɛ Nyo wu fɛwe le lɛɛɛ!”
Jiso gɛɛŋ wu fɛsɛ Yɛlusalɛm, wu lee fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le, wu bijɛ no mwɛɛ munchii nyume. Wu doo wu mɛsɛ a kife gɛɛŋ wa, bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ ja bo gɛɛŋ Bɛtani.
Jiso njiŋ kite kimi
Akfuuŋ bu ayuu Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo ja Bɛtani bo ka bo gɛɛne Yɛlusalɛm, jɛŋ tu yi yuu wu.
Wu yɛŋ kite kimi ki bojɛ je yì ndefe le kì ba to ba jii.
Wu mo wu gɛɛŋ fo ki wu yɛ̂ŋ laa le no wu ke fiɛɛ yi ki le wu ji la. Wu doo wu gɛɛŋ wu bu fo wu gɛ yɛŋ fiɛɛ le yi ki le gɛ, wu yɛŋ gɛh nyu biŋkamɛ le maa, nje gɛ gɛ̀ bee kife kì ki to ki yune gɛ.
Wu mo wu jɛmɛ kite kiyu le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ muh baaŋ wu ka wu yu wu to wu ji fiɛɛ yi wo le gɛ!”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo booŋ be ba ŋgoo yu.
Jiso kuŋ bamii ba waaŋ fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ yi Nyo le

Bo ja bo gɛɛŋ bo fɛsɛ Yɛlusalɛm, Jiso gɛɛŋ fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le wu kɛ wu kuŋe bamii ba gɛ̀ kamɛ waaŋ fo. Wu gɛ̀ kuŋe noo wu baaji bidaŋ bi bamii ba gɛ̀ kuse bige, mo binta bi bamii ba gɛ̀ gese bibɛmbɛ.
Wu faŋ lɛ keefɛ muh ka wu tuu fiɛɛ wu jiɛnyɛ wu daŋ bɛ fi fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le gɛ.
Wu tu wu yɛyi bo wu duu lɛ,

content.text: “Du ba gɛ̀ saŋ lɛ Nyo duu lɛ,
‘Yeh yaŋ ba lé ba tɛ̂ŋe lɛ yeh yi buunɛ yi bituŋ bichii?’
Geenɛ bɛŋ kaasɛ yi tu bvuta bvu bachoŋ.”

content: Bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ duunyi banchi gɛ̀ yu, bo tu bo goone je yì bo yuuyɛ wu yu. Bo gɛ̀ kɛme nfaaŋ kune wu nje kinchvu ki bamii gɛ̀ yuge n'yɛyɛ we bo yuge njoŋ.
Lɛ doo nyume fɛnfu, Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo bu a kilaantɛŋ kiyu le.
N'yɛyɛ wù jade yi kite kì Jiso gɛ̀ njiŋ kɛɛ le
Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo gɛ̀ bu bo fede antaana, bo yɛŋ kite kɛɛ le ki bobɛ wa kichii ki shii ki bu yi gɛŋ le.
Bita kwajɛ fiɛɛ fì chi kooshɛ, wu jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, yɛŋ no kite kɛɛ kì wo chi njiŋ le ki bobɛ wa.”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ bɛŋ leese fitele yi Nyo le,
nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, muh jɛme mbegɛ wunɛ le lɛ, ‘Mugɛ fɛnɛ wo gɛɛŋ wo gwe a joo yì baaŋ le’, wu duu noo wu maŋe gɛ a fitele le gɛ, wu bɛɛŋ lɛ fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme le fi kooshɛ, tu wu lé wu mûgɛ.
Noo, nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ, mo nyume la fì bɛŋ lɛge a buunɛ le, bɛŋ bɛɛŋ lɛ bɛŋ le bɛŋ kɛme wa, tu bɛŋ lé bɛŋ kɛ̂mɛ.
Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ lɛɛŋ tɛ ki bɛŋ bûune, fi nyume lɛ muh kɛme muh mu fɛ fitele le, wu lɛɛshɛ fiɛɛ fiyu. Bɛŋ gêe noo lɛ Chiji wene wù le fɛwe lɛɛshɛ tɛ biɛna bimbefɛ.
Nɛ bɛŋ baaŋ lɛɛshɛ gɛ bimbefɛ bi bamii bamu gɛ, Chiji wene wù le fɛwe gɛ lɛɛshɛ tɛ biɛna gɛ.”]

content: Bo biih fɛ bvuŋga bvu Jiso gɛ̀ ja fo

Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo ka bo gɛɛŋ bo lee Yɛlusalɛm. Wu gɛ̀ doo wu jiɛnyi fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le, bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba duunyi banchi ba Nyo mo bamii ba sage woŋ ja bo to bo yɛŋ wu le,
bo biih wu le lɛ, “Wo jo faaŋ bvuŋga ki wo gêe mwɛɛ munɛ? Nya yɛɛŋ bvuŋga bvuyu wo le ki wo gêe mwɛɛ munɛ?”
Jiso nchvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nle mbiih fiɛɛ bɛŋ le fimimia, bɛŋ nɛ le bɛŋ chvuu, mɛ mo nsɛɛŋ bɛŋ muh wu nya bvuŋga lɛ ŋgêe mwɛɛ munɛ yu.
Gɛ̀ nya yɛɛŋ bvuŋga Joŋ le ki wu lêese bamii a joo? Bvu gɛ̀ ja fɛwe noo gɛ̀ nya muh wu wuŋ le? Bɛŋ chvuu mɛne n'yu!”

content: Bo ja bo tu bo tɛɛnyi lɛbolɛbo lɛ, “Nɛ bee chvuse lɛ bvu gɛ̀ ja fɛwe, wu biih bee le laa gɛ̀ ge la lɛ keefɛ bee bɛɛŋ Joŋ le gɛ?
Bee chvuse lɛ gɛ̀ nya muh wu wuŋ, fi chiɛɛŋ yo?” Bo gɛ̀ faane bamii, nje bamii bachii gɛ̀ bɛɛŋ lɛ Joŋ gɛ̀ bee muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo.
Noo, bo mo bo chvuu Jiso le lɛ, “Gɛ bee kee gɛ.” Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Tu gɛ nyu nsɛ̂ɛŋ tɛ bɛŋ muh wù nya bvuŋga mɛne lɛ ŋgêe mwɛɛ munɛ yu gɛ.”

footnotes.text: Biwule binɛ le a jɛ́ yi Glek le lɛ Hosana.
Kite kinɛ le ki ba tɛŋe a jɛ yi bala le lɛ, “fig”.
Gɛ baŋwa ba kege bamu ba ba gɛ̀ ya saŋ jɛ yi Nyo yo kɛme kinchiŋ kinɛ gɛ.
